t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Best of Digital with Andy Cohen, Gayle King, Sean Evans, "50 First Dates" Reunion Sketch
st: Best of Digital with Andy Cohen, Gayle King, Sean Evans, "50 First Dates" Reunion Sketch
d: Drew's best of digital hour! Drew’s sit-downs with "Watch What Happens Live" Host Andy Cohen, "CBS This Morning" Co-Host Gayle King and "Hot Ones" host Sean Evans. Plus, a look at how our "50 First Dates" reunion sketch with Adam Sandler came together.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Drew's News, Cookbook Club with Tieghan Gerard, In A Minute Beauty Tip
st: Drew's News, Cookbook Club with Tieghan Gerard, In A Minute Beauty Tip
d: Drew and Ross Mathews are serving the news sunny-side up in an all new Drew's News. Then, it's an all-new Cookbook Club with "Half Baked Harvest" author Tieghan Gerard who is whipping up Finish Spicy Shrimp Tacos.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Leslie Grossman, Back To School Crew
st: Leslie Grossman, Back To School Crew
d: "American Horror Story: Double Feature" star Leslie Grossman stops by to chat.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Designed By Drew, Model Hunter McGrady, Former NFL Star Tiki Barber
st: Designed By Drew, Model Hunter McGrady, Former NFL Star Tiki Barber
d: Drew surprises a very deserving 22-year-old and her family with a living room makeover in Designed By Drew. Model Hunter McGrady on being a role model for body positivity. Former NY Giants star Tiki Barber co-pilots a special Drew’s News sports edition.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Gabe LaBelle, Chef Melissa King
st: Gabe LaBelle, Chef Melissa King
d: Drew and Ross Mathews are hitting the headlines in an all-new Drew's News. Drew chats with "The Fabelmans" star Gabe LaBelle who shares what it was like working with and portraying a young Steven Spielberg. Chef Melissa King joins Drew in the kitchen.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Relationship Red Flags with Martha Stewart, Drew's News with Josh Wolf, Drew Gooder
st: Relationship Red Flags with Martha Stewart, Drew's News with Josh Wolf, Drew Gooder
d: Icon Martha Stewart and Drew tackle relationship red flags at the news desk and Martha reveals which young star she simply adores.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Terry & Rebecca Crews, Cookbook Club with Kwame, Romance Refresh with The Young Emperors
st: Terry & Rebecca Crews, Cookbook Club with Kwame, Romance Refresh with The Young Emperors
d: ”America’s Got Talent's” Terry Crews and his wife Rebecca chat. Drew is joined by students who launched a zine which celebrates chefs of color. Kwame Onwuachi makes Jollof Rice with Jerk Rack of Lamb. Young Emperors give a married couple a fashion update.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: "The Talk" Hosts, Drew's News
st: "The Talk" Hosts, Drew's News
d: The hosts of "The Talk" Natalie Morales, Jerry O'Connell, Sheryl Underwood, Akbar Gbaja-Biamila and Amanda Kloots are joining Drew and taking on the final five to answer rapid fire questions about themselves!

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Jenny McCarthy, Lovebug: Grandma Dating App Edition, Drew-Gooder, Terence J
st: Jenny McCarthy, Lovebug: Grandma Dating App Edition, Drew-Gooder, Terence J
d: “The Masked Singer's” Jenny McCarthy chats. Grandma Joy picks a date for her granddaughter using a dating app. Meet Latrice McArthur, founder of the Wellness with Bella focused on healthy eating and meals for those in need. Terence J joins Drew’s News.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Chelsea Clinton, Danny Seo, Drew Gooder: Free Mom Hugs
st: Chelsea Clinton, Danny Seo, Drew Gooder: Free Mom Hugs
d: Chelsea Clinton stops by to chat. Danny Seo stops by to whip up sticky toffee baked oatmeal bars and share how to upcycle leftover ingredients into DIY slime. In “Drew Gooder,” meet the mom and son team behind the non-profit organization, Free Mom Hugs.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Jonathan Groff, Amanda Gorman, Holiday Crafts with Lindsey Peers
st: Jonathan Groff, Amanda Gorman, Holiday Crafts with Lindsey Peers
d: "The Matrix Resurrections" star Jonathan Groff stops by to chat. Plus, Amanda Gorman joins Drew to discuss her new book of poetry, "Call Us What We Carry: Poems." Then, Lindsey Peers of "The Craft Studio" is teaching us how to make a fun holiday craft.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Naomi Ava DuVernay, & Kaci Walfall, Drew's News
st: Naomi Ava DuVernay, & Kaci Walfall, Drew's News
d: Ava DuVernay and Kaci Walfall stop by to chat about their groundbreaking new superhero series "Naomi."

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: “Girls5eva” Cast, Andrew McCarthy, Cooking with Molly Baz, Sunny Hostin
st: “Girls5eva” Cast, Andrew McCarthy, Cooking with Molly Baz, Sunny Hostin
d: “Girls5eva” cast Sara Bareilles, Busy Philipps, Paula Pell and Renée Elise Goldsberry join Drew. Andrew McCarthy on his new memoir “Brat: An ‘80’s Story.” Molly Baz whips up a Miso Apple Tart. “Summer on the Bluffs” author Sunny Hostin joins Drew’s News.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show
st: "Charlie’s Angels" Reunion With Cameron Diaz & Lucy Liu, Adam Sandler
d: "The Drew Barrymore Show" kicks-off its premiere episode with a "Charlie’s Angels" reunion with Cameron Diaz and Lucy Liu. Drew also reunites with longtime friend / co-star Adam Sandler. Drew has a big surprise for a deserving family of essential workers.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: The D'Amelio Family, Drew's News
st: The D'Amelio Family, Drew's News
d: The most followed family on TikTok and stars of "The D'Amelio Show," Charli, Dixie, Heidi and Marc D'Amelio reveal what it's like sharing their life with over 224 million people around the world.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Actress Annaleigh Ashford, Olympic Snowboarder Jamie Anderson
st: Actress Annaleigh Ashford, Olympic Snowboarder Jamie Anderson
d: Actress Annaleigh Ashford chats. Drew has a big surprise for nurse Gina Goodwin, who cooks and delivers hundreds of meals every Thanksgiving. Olympic snowboarder Jamie Anderson shares her winter skin routine. Drew reads letters in "Dear Drew."

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Taye Diggs, Herb Garden & Cooking with Michael Symon, “The Prom” Star Jo Ellen Pellman
st: Taye Diggs, Herb Garden & Cooking with Michael Symon, “The Prom” Star Jo Ellen Pellman
d: “All American” star Taye Diggs joins Drew to chat. Iron Chef Michael Symon teaches Drew how to make a hydroponic indoor herb garden and then shares how to use those home-grown herbs in a vegetable soup. Drew’s News with “The Prom” star Jo Ellen Pellman.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Lilly Singh, Butcher Loreal Gavin, Sean Evans
st: Lilly Singh, Butcher Loreal Gavin, Sean Evans
d: “A Little Late with Lilly Singh” host Lilly Singh stops by to chat. “Hot Ones” host Sean Evans joins Drew and Ross in Drew’s News. Butcher and author of “The Butcher Babe Cookbook” Loreal Gavin shares her special marinade revealing her secret ingredient.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Drew-Gooder Surprise, Drew's News
st: Drew-Gooder Surprise, Drew's News
d: Plus, Drew and Ross Mathews are serving the news sunny side up in an all-new Drew's News. Plus, in an all-new Drew-Gooder, Drew is surprising a very deserving do-gooder in a big way!

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Jessica Biel, Melanie Lynskey, Ryan Kiera Armstrong, Drew's News
st: Jessica Biel, Melanie Lynskey, Ryan Kiera Armstrong, Drew's News
d: "Candy" stars Jessica Biel and Melanie Lynskey stop by to chat. Plus, "Firestarter" star Ryan Kiera Armstrong. Then, Drew and Ross Mathews are serving the news sunny-side up in an all new Drew's News.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Jaleel White, Cooking School with Anne Burrell, Drew's News
st: Jaleel White, Cooking School with Anne Burrell, Drew's News
d: Actor Jaleel White stops by to chat about his "Ever After" podcast and plays a fun game of "Did I Do That?" with Drew. Plus, Chef Anne Burrell joins Drew to teach an easy and delicious recipe of Chicken Milanese.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Paul Feig, Drew's News with Zainab Johnson, Birthday Cake with Milk Bar Founder Christina Tosi
st: Paul Feig, Drew's News with Zainab Johnson, Birthday Cake with Milk Bar Founder Christina Tosi
d: Director, writer and producer Paul Feig on his new series "Welcome To Flatch." Founder of the renowned Milk Bar Christina Tosi whips up her signature birthday cake in the kitchen with Drew.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Katy Perry, Drew's News, In A Minute Selma Blair Sneak Peak
st: Katy Perry, Drew's News, In A Minute Selma Blair Sneak Peak
d: Drew takes the show on the road to join Katy Perry on-site at her Las Vegas residency, PLAY. Then, Drew and Ross Mathews are serving the news sunny-side up in an all new Drew's News.

t: The Drew Barrymore Show: Laura Prepon, Cooking with Babs, Abbi Jacobson
st: Laura Prepon, Cooking with Babs, Abbi Jacobson
d: Actress Laura Prepon shares her new kitchen gadget line. The grandmother behind TikTok's Brunch with Babs, Barbara Costello, joins Drew and Laura in the kitchen to whip up a dish. Netflix’s “The Mitchells vs. The Machines” star Abbi Jacobson joins Drew.
